title: Continuity cards, version 1
description: How each character starts each story day. A story day is a day inside the story, not a day of work. The shot sheet (shot-sheet.v1.schema.json) carries a card's state from shot to shot and records every change with its reason. Declared in the registry as a surface of type continuity-cards. Field reference: docs/3-reference/CONTINUITY-CARD-AND-SHOT-SHEET-FIELDS.md. Keys starting with _ are notes anywhere and are never checked.

story_days.description: The days inside the story, in order, keyed by a short id (day-1). A scene header names one of them.

label.description: One line a person reads: The night of the text.

weather.description: The day's weather, carried into every scene of the day unless a scene header says otherwise.

cards.description: One card per character per story day: cards.<registry id>.<story day>.

wardrobe.description: Expected one line of text or an object of layers (outer, top, bottom, shoes; any other key is kept). A layer whose value is none is left out. Required unless the surface says otherwise.

hair.description: How the hair is worn today (pinned up, loose, under a cap). Who the character is, hair colour included, belongs in the registry's look form.

accessories.description: Worn things: a pendant, glasses, a watch on the left wrist. Carried until a change takes one off.

marks.description: Injuries, dirt, wet, smudged makeup: anything on the body that must stay until a change says it is gone. Marks that end a day and are missing from the next day's card are reported.

carries.description: Registry ids of props (kind prop) the character has with them today: in hand, pocket or bag. A shot may show in hand only what is carried at that moment.
